story.title: The Star That Fell and Swallowed the King

narrator.persona: a calm, warm storyteller, like a nature documentary narrator who is quietly afraid

sentences.text: The great tyrannosaur ruled these ancient ferns under a peaceful night sky.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: Herds grazed quietly while winged reptiles soared past a strange extra star.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: Suddenly that star split into a thousand blazing fragments.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: Fire rained down and every beast in the valley fled in terror.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: Deep in the largest impact crater, a strange anomaly began to stir.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: A floating mass of flesh with one huge eye, a ring of teeth for a mouth and many trailing tentacles crawled out into the ash.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: The brave king roared and charged, but it opened slowly and beautifully before it struck.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: Now this terribly slow horror rules the valley, and do you think you could outwalk it?
sentences.speaker: narrator
